import unittest
from collections import UserDict
from solution import select_records


class SelectRecordsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ascending_descending_and_stable_ties(self):
        records = [
            {"rank": 2, "id": "first-two"},
            {"rank": 1, "id": "one"},
            {"rank": 2, "id": "second-two"},
        ]
        ascending = select_records(records, False)
        descending = select_records(records, True)
        self.assertEqual([r["id"] for r in ascending], ["one", "first-two", "second-two"])
        self.assertEqual([r["id"] for r in descending], ["first-two", "second-two", "one"])
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["id"], "first-two")

    def test_returns_new_deep_copied_dictionaries(self):
        records = [UserDict({"rank": 1, "nested": {"items": [1]}})]
        result = select_records(records, False)
        self.assertIs(type(result[0]), dict)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], records[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["nested"], records[0]["nested"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["nested"]["items"], records[0]["nested"]["items"])
        records[0]["nested"]["items"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["nested"]["items"], [1])
        result[0]["nested"]["items"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["nested"]["items"], [1, 2])

    def test_empty_and_generator_inputs(self):
        self.assertEqual(select_records([], False), [])
        result = select_records((record for record in [{"rank": -1}, {"rank": 0}]), True)
        self.assertEqual(result, [{"rank": 0}, {"rank": -1}])

    def test_rejects_invalid_top_level_types(self):
        for records in ("records", b"records", None, 3):
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    select_records(records, False)
        for descending in (0, 1, None, "true"):
            with self.subTest(descending=descending):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    select_records([], descending)

    def test_validates_all_records_before_sorting(self):
        nested = [1]
        records = [{"rank": 2, "nested": nested}, {"missing": 1}]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_records(records, False)
        self.assertEqual(records, [{"rank": 2, "nested": [1]}, {"missing": 1}])
        for bad in (None, [], 4):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    select_records([{"rank": 1}, bad], False)

    def test_rank_validation_excludes_boolean(self):
        for rank in (True, False, 1.0, "1", None):
            with self.subTest(rank=rank):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    select_records([{"rank": rank}], False)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
